corpus: CLINICAL LABORATORY REFERENCE RANGE AND SPECIMEN HANDLING SHEET (SYNTHETIC, illustrative only; not derived from any accredited laboratory's proprietary reference intervals or standard operating procedures). Basic Metabolic Panel. The reference range for sodium is 135-145 mmol/L. The critical value for sodium is below 120 mmol/L or above 160 mmol/L. Sodium specimen volume is 1 mL of serum collected in a gold-top tube. The reference range for potassium is 3.5-5.1 mmol/L. The critical value for potassium is above 6.5 mmol/L. Potassium turnaround time is 45 minutes for a stat order. The reference range for fasting glucose is 70-99 mg/dL, drawn after an 8 hour fast. Hematology. The reference range for hemoglobin in adult males is 13.5-17.5 g/dL. The reference range for hemoglobin in adult females is 12.0-15.5 g/dL. Hemoglobin specimens are stable for 24 hours at room temperature before analysis is required. The reference range for platelet count is 150-400 K/uL. The critical value for platelet count is below 20 K/uL. Renal Function. The reference range for creatinine in adult males is 0.74-1.35 mg/dL. The reference range for creatinine in adult females is 0.59-1.04 mg/dL. Cardiac Markers. The critical value for troponin I is above 0.4 ng/mL. Troponin I specimens are stable for 48 hours refrigerated at 2-8 degrees C before analysis is required.
